3) Verify No Inference policy:
- Ensure fields are explicitly present. All chosen values appear explicitly:
  - Grand total explicitly "Endbetrag EUR 740,99".
  - Invoice date explicitly "Wien am 19-01-2024".
  - Sender VAT explicitly "UID-Nr.: ATU 43349701".
  - VAT rate and amounts explicitly shown.
- Do not infer currency or other fields beyond schema.

4) Number formatting for JSON:
- Convert numbers using dot decimal separator and retain decimal places:
  - 740,99 -> 740.99
  - 673,63 -> 673.63
  - 67,36 -> 67.36
  - VAT rate 10 -> number 10

5) Final mapping:
- GrandTotal.Amount: 740.99
- Invoice.Date: "19-01-2024"
- Sender.VatId: "ATU43349701"
- Vat.Rate: 10
- Net.Amount: 673.63
